item.title: BCB decides not to send Bangladesh team to India for T20 World Cup 2026 after Mustafizur Rahman row
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has decided not to send its senior men's cricket team to India for the upcoming ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 in India. item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) is open to shifting Bangladesh’s T20 World Cup 2026 fixtures out of India after the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) formally requested a venue change citing security concerns, Cricbuzz reported. item.title: Pune's MCA Stadium may stage RCB or RR’s home fixtures in IPL 2026
item.description: Pune’s Maharashtra Cricket Association (MCA) Stadium might stage Rajasthan Royals’ or Royal Challengers Bengaluru’s home fixtures in the 2026 edition of Indian Premier League (IPL). In a statement released on Sunday (January 4), the MCA confirmed that officials of defending champions RCB and inaugural IPL champions RR visited MCA Stadium two weeks ago. MCA also expressed confidence that the BCCI will approve the MCA International Stadium as a venue for one of these franchises in the near future.

item.description: The Ben Stokes-led England side arrived in Australia with a lot of expectations, but ended up conceding the Ashes urn in just 11 days -- the joint-second quickest in more than a century.
